spec.description:
Autex Solid Colour Quietspace is a high-performance broadband acoustic panel
engineered to deliver maximum acoustic absorption finished in custom solid
colours. Built on a dual-density 100% polyester Quietspace Panel core, solid
colour finishes—including custom paint matching, CMYK, and Pantone
specifications—are digitally applied with safe, water-based UV-cured ink or
laminated with solid-colour Vertiface fabric. It absorbs between 85% and 100% of
sound energy (NRC 0.85 - 1.00) while seamlessly harmonising with any interior
colour scheme.

install:
Inspect wall or
ceiling substrate to ensure it is flat, clean, dry, and dust-free

Acclimatise
panels in the installation environment for at least 24 hours prior to fitting

Keep protective spun-bond cover on panel face during handling and
installation

Apply recommended contact or high-grab MS polymer adhesive
evenly across the panel back

Position panel onto substrate, butt joins
tightly, and roll firmly with a pressure roller

Peel back protective film
corners during painting and remove fully upon completion

Calculate total panel count based on 1200mm x 2400mm dimensions
Determine need for aluminium edge trims (Autex Type C profile for 25mm)

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Solid Colour Quietspace pairs the premium broadband sound
absorption of dual-density Quietspace Panel (NRC 0.85 to 1.00) with custom solid
colour finishes across the entire spectrum. Available in thicknesses from 25mm
to 100mm in 1200mm x 2400mm sheets, it offers custom paint, CMYK, and Pantone
matching printed with safe water-based inks or fabric-laminated faces. Achieving
Group 1 fire compliance under AS ISO 9705 and containing over 45% recycled PET,
it provides architecturally seamless, colour-coordinated noise control for
corporate, education, and entertainment venues.
